text:
Short answer: yes, we should be able to deploy to staging today.

All 212 tests are passing. One flaky test needed a retry but passed on the second attempt, so I'm not worried about it.

We're just waiting on QA sign-off, which should come by 3 pm. The deploy window closes at 5 pm, so that leaves enough time to ship today. I'll post here as soon as QA signs off.
